ruflo gaia-bench
GAIA benchmark harness -- measure agent pass-rate on real GAIA questions

SUBCOMMANDS:
  run             Run GAIA benchmark questions against one or more models

EXAMPLES:
  $ claude-flow gaia-bench run --level 1 --limit 10 --models claude-haiku-4-5 --output json
    Mini Level-1 run with Haiku, JSON output
  $ claude-flow gaia-bench run --smoke-only
    Quick smoke test with built-in fixture (no HF token)
  $ claude-flow gaia-bench run --level 1 --models claude-sonnet-4-6 --hardness-routing --output json
    ADR-136 Track Q: tiered compute routing by predicted question difficulty
  $ claude-flow gaia-bench run --level 1 --models claude-sonnet-4-6 --hardness-routing --enable-critic --planning-interval 4
    Recommended config: all tracks active, ~$2/run estimated
